rule.name: TCS_ER_BannerMessage
rule.description: Banner message expression rule for end users. Displays a maintenance warning, an active custom banner, or a default welcome message based on system constants MAINTENANCE_MODE and ACTIVE_BANNER_MESSAGE.
rule.definition:
/* ============================================================ TCS_ER_BannerMessage — End User Banner Message
Displays a dynamic banner message to end users based on system constants:
Constants Used: cons!MAINTENANCE_MODE - Boolean - true during maintenance cons!ACTIVE_BANNER_MESSAGE - Text - Custom banner message
Returns: Text - Banner message to be shown on the interface
Usage: rule!TCS_ER_BannerMessage()
Referenced by: Interface: TCS_IF_BannerMessage ============================================================ */ if( cons!MAINTENANCE_MODE = true, "⚠️ System Maintenance: The system is currently under maintenance. Please try again later.", if( not(isnull(cons!ACTIVE_BANNER_MESSAGE)), cons!ACTIVE_BANNER_MESSAGE, "✅ Welcome! All systems are operating normally. For support, contact helpdesk@company.com" ) )
